title: Duckie's Peaceful +
description: A mod that aims to add new ways to get features that are not possible to get in regular peaceful mode
body:
## Duckie's Peaceful +
With this mod, items and blocks that were normally not available in peaceful mode are now available. 

## Additions
- New item: Blank Disc Fragment. Obtained from smelting a "5" disc fragment or any other music disc. can be crafted into other music discs
- New structure: Prismarine Shrine. Has one chest that can contain various loot, including tide armor trims, nautolis shells, primarine shards, and trident shards.
- New item: Trident shard. Can be used to craft a trident.
- New item: Broken Soul Shard and Soul Shard Block. It can be used in various recipes to make mob heads, totems, and a levitation potion.
- New item: Dragon Totem. Can be crafted and then used in the end dimension to kill the Ender Dragon and receive the achievement.
- New recipes: You can now craft gunpowder, breeze rods, both variants of trial keys, string, bones, and saddles.  
- New trades: Clerics can now sell slimeballs, blaze rods, and spider eyes. Wandering traders can now sell phantom membranes.
